div.p: A single dispenser. As a server it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a client it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.

description.value: Un distributeur de chocolat, qui agit à la fois comme serveur FHIR et comme client FHIR.

documentation.value:
A single dispenser. As a **server** it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a **client** it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.
See [Interfaces](interfaces.html).
